title: docs(skills): teach the null-guard gate on a record-triggered flow's conditions in the formula skill and the flows page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBUyArWn6eHL33NNgvdpkwiW)_
Fixes #29482

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：formula 技能与 flows 文档页补上「空值守卫门禁也判记录触发流的条件」的教学：判哪些槽位（start `config.condition`、每条边 `condition` 含嵌套区域、每个 `decision` 分支 `expression`）、`count`/`sum` 汇总字段恒有值而 `min`/`max`/`avg` 仍可空、裸字段名即 `record.FIELD`、start 条件里的守卫在下游每条边与分支都算数且要拼成 `record.FIELD != null` 两道门才都收、未守卫时「写入落地、流运行失败」。技能 evals 新增一条被拒的流边。
- 为什么改：PR #29474 已让 `os validate` / `os build` 与运行时发布门拒收这类流条件，技能与文档仍只说 validation rule 与 hook，作者会在无教学的情况下撞上拒收。
- 风险与回滚：仅教学文本与一条 eval，不动任何代码或 schema；回滚即 revert 本 PR。`skills/**` 为 Tier H，等维护者批准后由席位落地。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` 第 115–125 行（发布时拒收段落）与第 399–407 行（流条件例外的 callout）；`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 的 Expressions in flows 警告框第 5 条。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md is 5956 tokens (ceiling 5997; headroom 41)`。
- 需要你做的：批准（Tier H：`skills/**`）；之后席位落地。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`** (491 → 487 lines against `main` after PR #29439, net −4; 5948 → 5956 tokens of 5997, headroom 41). Two paragraphs teach what `packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts` (the ledger's flow row) and `validate-expressions.ts` (`checkFlowNullGuards`) do as merged in PR #29474:
  - the publish-time rejection paragraph (lines 115–125) names the flow slots the gate judges on a record-triggered flow (start `triggerType: 'record-*'`): start `config.condition`, edge `condition` (nested regions too), `decision` branch `expression` — beside the validation-rule and hook predicates it already named — and adds the roll-up nuance to the nullable definition: a `count` / `sum` summary is always valued (empty reads `0`), `min` / `max` / `avg` stay nullable;
  - the "Flow conditions are the exception to row 1" callout (lines 399–407) carries the bare-name rule (the run spreads the trigger record's fields, nulls included, to top level wherever no flow variable or node id holds the name, so a bare `budget` IS `record.budget`; `os validate` judges either spelling, bare names only while the flow's bound names are provable; a guard on one guards both), the start-condition presumption (what the start condition proves non-null holds at every edge and branch), the two-door spelling (`record.budget != null`: the runtime publish gate judges the written flow alone and resolves no bare name) and the outcome (the **run** fails at that condition; the write that fired it still lands).
  - Paid by deleting restatement in the same file, never by re-wrapping: the `OLD.x` / `ISCHANGED(x)` callout (6 → 3 lines) restated §5's `previous` table and its ABORTS paragraph; the "Verify your work" opener dropped its pre-ADR-0032 history clause; and after PR #29439 (#29094) landed on `main` and the merged file read 6086 tokens (over by 89), three more: the "Null + string throws" section (it restated pattern 1, *always coalesce nullable operands* — "CEL throws on null + string"), the ABORTS paragraph's compile sentence (pattern 3 states it) and its insert-leg remedy sentence (the `previous` table's insert row and the `OLD.x` callout state it), and the flow callout's own "prefer `record.x`" sentence (row 1 of the table above it says the same).
  - PR #29439's sparse-action paragraph and its edit to the total-record paragraph are untouched; the merge of `origin/main` @ `4b71a82b` auto-merged this file with no conflict.
- **`skills/objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json`** (85 → 95 lines; eval fixture, measured but not ratcheted — 1504 → 1769 tokens): eval 9 asks for the edge condition of a record-change flow on a nullable `budget`; expected `record.budget != null && record.budget > 200000`, must not contain the `has()`-only trap.
- **`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`** (3061 → 3073 lines, net +12): item 5 of the "failure modes to memorize" callout in *Expressions in flows* — the slots, the nullable definition with the roll-up nuance, the `!= null` / `== null` / `!isBlank()` guard, why (the run binds every declared field, `null` when empty; CEL has no `>` for null; the run fails there while the write lands), the bare-name rule and the start-guard spelling; the Edges table's `condition` row points at it (same row, no new line).
- **`.changeset/29482-formula-skill-flow-null-guards.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.

## Why

PR #29474 (#29026) widened the null-guard gate to record-triggered flow conditions and left `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`. Until this lands, an author who reads the skill or the flows page writes `budget > 200000` on an edge and meets the refusal untaught; the skill said the gate covers "any validation-rule or hook predicate" and nothing about flows, and the flows page had no nullable-field rule at all.

## Tests

Every sentence was read off the merged code, then measured against it (readings repeated on the merged head `d97d2e33`, unchanged; `554bea27` adds one wording edit to the callout, same line and token count):

- `packages/lint` null-guard suites under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts` + `src/validate-null-guards.test.ts` — Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 46 passed (46); lock verdict command-exit 0.
- A probe through `tsx` against `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (`validateStackExpressions` = the `os validate` door; `runStackExpressionPasses(…, { runtimeWriteType: 'flow' })` = the runtime publish gate) on a `record-after-update` flow over `project` (`budget` currency, nullable; `line_count` a `count` summary; `largest` a `max` summary):

  | condition | `os validate` | runtime publish gate |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | edge `budget > 200000` (bare) | refused at edge `e2` | not judged (bare name unresolvable there) |
  | edge `record.budget > 200000` | refused | refused |
  | edge `has(record.budget) && record.budget > 200000` | refused | refused |
  | edge `record.budget != null && record.budget > 200000` (eval 9's answer) | accepted | accepted |
  | start `budget != null`, edge `record.budget > 200000` | accepted | refused |
  | start `record.budget != null`, same edge | accepted | accepted |
  | edge `line_count > 1` (`count` roll-up) | accepted | accepted |
  | edge `largest > 1` (`max` roll-up) | refused | not judged (bare) |

  The second commit (`487ad8da`) is what that table changed: the three places that said "the gate judges a bare name" / "refused the same way" now say `os validate`, since the runtime gate judges no bare name.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (docs, a skill and an eval fixture).

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured on the branch base (`origin/main` @ `c76c0e04`): `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` line 113 opened "**This is a publish-time rejection, not advice.**", the file had no `record_change` / `record-triggered` mention (0 hits; "record-change flow trigger" appears only in §5's bulk-write table, which teaches `previous`, not the gate), and `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` had no `nullable` (0 hits). The order's premise holds.
- The order's line budgets hold: SKILL.md net +6 against the base (473 → 479) and net −4 against `main` after the token payback (491 → 487); flows.mdx net +12 (3061 → 3073). The evals file got the one eval the card asks for (+10 lines); the order set no numeric budget for it and the token ratchet measures but does not ratchet eval fixtures.
- Token reading for the Tier H review: 5948 (`main`) → 5956 (ceiling 5997, headroom 41). Every token paid is a deletion in the same file, listed above; no ceiling row moves.
- The Basic Structure example (`order_amount > 10000`) is left as it is: that flow has no record trigger and `order_amount` is a declared variable, so the gate does not judge it — the rule is taught where edge and decision conditions are taught (the *Expressions in flows* callout and the Edges table).
- The skill's "bare names only while the flow's bound names are provable" is `flowCelRootScope`'s own criterion (the bound set is unprovable with a `script`, `subflow`, `map`, `wait`, `connector_action` or plugin node, an entrance that hands a record not in hand, or a contract-less screen); the full list stays in the code.
- The previous-operand clause (`previous != null && previous.x != null` on a flow's create leg) is not restated: §5 and the `OLD.x` callout already teach it for every surface that binds `previous`.
- Out of scope, noted, not filed: none.

## Verification

Head `554bea27`: the two commits on `c76c0e04`, a merge of `origin/main` @ `4b71a82b`, one payback commit, and one wording commit from the at-tier review (record 6599648862). Readings taken on `d97d2e33` unless marked; the wording commit changed one blockquote line and no reading.

<details><summary>Package readings</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build --concurrency=2` under the lock after the merge: VERDICT command-exit 0, held 484s.
- Lint null-guard suites (above): 2 files, 46/46, lock verdict 0, on the merged head.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` :: exit 0 (the `.claude/**` line ratchet; this diff touches none of its files — run because the order asks). `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` :: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 68 commands, run serially, `CMD :: exit N` recorded, reconciled with `--ran`</summary>

- On head `487ad8da` (before the merge): `--ran` reconciliation `68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`; change set 4 paths, 70 changed lines (+54 / −16), under the 3000 human-merge threshold. 66 run, every one `:: exit 0`, among them `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-skills-token-ratchet` (+ self-test), `check-doc-route-spelling`, `check-docs-section-name`, `check-section-landing-index`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `@objectstack/spec check:docs`, `check:empty-state`, `check:liveness`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:variant-docs`, `check:yaml-examples`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-frontmatter`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:published-files`, `check:published-readme-links`, `check:role-word`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:merge-driver`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:vendor-version-stamps`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, and the `--self-test` rows of the ci / release scripts.
- On the merged head `d97d2e33` (and again on `554bea27` for `check-skills-token-ratchet` + self-test, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `@objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, all `:: exit 0`), the families the skill and docs edits read, rerun: `check-skills-token-ratchet` (+ self-test) 5956 / 5997, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:role-word`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `@objectstack/spec check:skill-docs`, `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (283 prose examples type-check across 3 surfaces, after the post-merge closure build), `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions` — all `:: exit 0`.
- NOT MEASURED (2): `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` — both exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they load every package's built `dist/`, which needs a full repo build this docs-and-skill diff does not warrant on the shared box (no package `src/` moves); CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` run is the reading for those two.

</details>
